transcript.content: Hi, this is Lucas Brown. I have reservation EUJUY6, and I need to change my flight date—push it out by two days. My wife passed away yesterday and I'm not in any state to travel right now. I don't want to cancel, I just need to move the date back.
I'm so sorry for your loss. Let me pull up your details right away.

I've located your reservation. I'm truly sorry for what you're going through.

Unfortunately, I'm not able to modify the flights on this reservation. It was booked in **basic economy**, and flight date changes are not permitted for basic economy tickets — this is a firm policy restriction that I'm unable to override.

The only option available for this reservation would be cancellation. Since your reservation does have travel insurance, and a family member's passing would qualify as a health-related reason, you may be eligible for a full refund if you'd like to explore that path instead.

Would you like me to look into a cancellation with a refund under your insurance, or is there anything else I can help you with?
No, I don't want to cancel. I understand you can't change it. Thank you for checking.
